title: 第19章 企业文化 求推荐求月票第20章 洞府 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
真传峰外云气渐散。
楚无忌方向一折，沿着青石大道往长老院方向行去。
筑基之后，他的遁速比练气时驾驭飞行法器快了何止一倍，法力一转，催动小风遁术加持，速度陡然再提，竟隐隐逼近筑基中期修士的遁速。
一路上遇到的内外门弟子、执事，远远瞧见那股隐隐压来的灵压，便自觉停步拱手，口称“师叔”。
长老院坐落于青玄门主峰偏北，院墙不高，却处处禁制流转。
青砖之上刻满细密阵纹，远远望去，隐约有一层无色光幕笼罩其外，若非细看，几乎难以察觉。
门前两尊石狮盘踞，一阴一阳，气机相扣，隐约是整座阵法的核心。
他落下遁光，整了整衣袖，随即踏入院门。
长老院前厅值守的执事弟子一见他腰间真传令牌，却隐约传来筑基气息，连忙起身行礼：“恭喜师叔筑就道基，结丹可期，还请师叔稍坐片刻，弟子这就去请主事的刘师叔。”
不多时，一名须发灰白的筑基修士自内堂出来，面相不怒自威，眼神却不锐，显得颇为稳重。
他上下打量楚无忌片刻，笑了笑：“楚师侄……不，楚师弟如今也是筑基同道。恭喜了。”
楚无忌拱手回礼，神色不卑不亢：“见过刘师兄，楚某按例来长老院录名。”
刘姓修士点了点头，也不多话，转身将他引入内堂。
内堂陈设极简，却自有一股森严气象。
一面古旧铜镜高悬梁上，镜面刻满符文，隐隐有灵光游走；堂中供着一块黝黑石碑，碑上密密麻麻皆是名字。
再往深处，是一张宽大的紫檀长案，案后整面墙壁上，赫然悬挂着五幅修士画像。画中之人，或威武霸气，或缥缈洒脱，乃青玄门开山立派以来，仅有的五位达到元婴境界的祖师。
然而，自八百余年前，最后一位元婴祖师归元真君坐化之后，青玄门越发青黄不接，至今再无一人能突破元婴，声威也一落千丈。
甚至还在四百多年前丢失了祖地青玄岛，被一名散修血影老怪所夺。
血影上人此人本是魔道大派出身，后不知为何弑师叛宗而逃成了散修，其侥幸结婴后缺少潜修灵脉，趁着青玄门青黄不接的空当，一举夺岛，并悍然将其易名为玄阴岛，并以此为据点，不断鲸吞青玄门资源点。
彼时青玄门元气大伤，无力硬撼，即使耗费巨资联系了正道第一宗门万法门，最终也还是被迫让渡大量资源点与玄阴岛，两宗在万法门见证下讲和。讲和后，青玄门正式迁徙至当时位列第三的附属灵岛，将此岛更名为青玄岛，苟延残喘至今。

虽说那血影老怪作恶多端，却在夺岛不到两百年后，不知为何便匆匆坐化，算是给了青玄门一丝喘息之机。然而，其衣钵传人结丹后期的玄骨上人依旧是个狠角色，一身魔功诡谲强横。
当时几位幸存的结丹真人深谙“存人失地”之理，深知门派实力衰微，绝非斗法强横的玄骨上人的对手。故而，即便心中有万千不甘，也只能按下怒火，暂且隐忍。在他们看来，若无十足的把握，在没有培养出新的元婴修士之前，绝不可轻易去玄阴岛讨要交代。
楚无忌还在回忆青玄门过往种种，耳畔就传来刘姓修士的声音。
“先照例验身。”
刘姓修士抬手一招。
content_en:
The clouds outside Zhenzhuan Peak gradually dispersed.
Chu Wuji turned around and walked along the Qingshi Avenue towards the Elder's House.
After the foundation was established, his escape speed was more than twice as fast as the flying magic weapon during Qi training. With a turn of mana, he activated the blessing of the small wind escape technique, and the speed suddenly increased again, and it was faintly approaching the escape speed of the monks in the middle stage of the foundation establishment.
The inner and outer sect disciples and deacons I met along the way saw the faint pressure of spiritual pressure from a distance, and they consciously stopped and raised their hands, calling them "Uncle Master".
The Presbytery is located to the north of the main peak of Qingxuanmen. The walls of the courtyard are not high, but circulation is prohibited everywhere.
The green bricks are engraved with fine patterns. From a distance, there is a vague colorless light curtain covering the outside. It is almost difficult to detect unless you look closely.
Two stone lions are entrenched in front of the door, one yin and one yang, and the energy is interlocked, which is vaguely the core of the entire formation.
He dropped the light, straightened his sleeves, and then stepped into the courtyard.
When the deacon disciple on duty in the front hall of the presbytery saw the True Inheritance Token on his waist, he faintly sensed the aura of foundation building. He quickly stood up and saluted: "Congratulations, uncle, for building the Tao foundation. The elixir formation is expected. Please sit down for a moment. I will go and invite the master in charge, Master Liu."
Not long after, a foundation-building monk with gray beard and hair came out of the inner hall. His face was not angry or intimidating, but his eyes were not sharp, and he looked quite steady.
He looked Chu Wuji up and down for a moment and smiled: "Senior nephew Chu... No, junior brother Chu is also a fellow foundation builder now. Congratulations."
Chu Wuji returned the gift with his hand raised, his expression neither humble nor arrogant: "I've met Senior Brother Liu. As usual, Mr. Chu came to the Elder's House to register his name."
The monk surnamed Liu nodded, turned around and led him into the inner hall without saying much.
The furnishings in the inner hall are minimalist, but they have a solemn atmosphere.
An ancient bronze mirror hangs high on the beam. The mirror is engraved with runes, and there is a faint spiritual light wandering around. There is a dark stone tablet in the hall, and the tablet is densely packed with names.
Further down, there is a large long red sandalwood case. On the entire wall behind the case, five portraits of monks hang impressively. The people in the painting may be mighty and domineering, or ethereal and free and easy. They are the only five founders of Qingxuan Sect who have reached the realm of Yuanying since the sect was founded.
However, since the last Yuan Ying Patriarch returned to the throne of the Yuan Zhenjun more than 800 years ago, the Qingxuan Sect has become more and more out of touch. No one has been able to break through the Yuan Ying, and its reputation has also plummeted.
He even lost his ancestral land, Qingxuan Island, more than 400 years ago, and it was taken over by an old monster named Blood Shadow who was a casual cultivator.
Master Xueying was originally from a major demon sect, but for some unknown reason he killed his master and rebelled against the sect and fled to become a casual cultivator. Fortunately, he lacked the latent cultivator spiritual veins after having a baby. Taking advantage of the Qingxuan Sect's lack of support, he seized the island in one fell swoop and blatantly renamed it Xuanyin Island. He used it as a stronghold to continuously devour Qingxuan Sect's resource points.
At that time, the Qingxuan Sect's vitality was severely weakened and it was unable to fight back. Even though it spent huge sums of money to contact the Wanfa Sect, the first sect of the righteous way, it was eventually forced to give up a large number of resource points and Xuanyin Island. The two sects made peace in the presence of the Wanfa Sect. After the peace was reached, the Qingxuan Sect officially moved to the affiliated Ling Island, which was ranked third at the time. The island was renamed Qingxuan Island and has survived to this day.
Although the old monster with blood shadow did many evil things, he died in a hurry for some reason less than two hundred years after seizing the island, which gave Qingxuan Sect a chance to breathe. However, the successor of his mantle, Master Xuan Gu, who was in the later stage of pill formation, was still a ruthless character, possessing treacherous and tyrannical magic skills.
At that time, the few surviving Jiedan masters were well versed in the principle of "saving people and losing ground". They knew that the strength of the sect was declining and they were no match for Master Xuangu, who was powerful in fighting skills. Therefore, even if there is a lot of unwillingness in my heart, I can only suppress my anger and endure it for the time being. In their view, if they are not completely sure, they must not easily go to Xuanyin Island to ask for an explanation before a new Nascent Soul cultivator has been trained.
Chu Wuji was still recalling the past of Qingxuan Sect when the voice of the monk surnamed Liu came to his ears.
"First take a physical examination as usual."
The monk surnamed Liu raised his hand and waved.
